answer: Settlement re-runs a random spot-check of 9 previously graded answers per epoch, and any account whose old answer now fails a fresh panel loses its pending emission. A farm that mass-produced near-identical text gets caught at replay, so its atlas of answers turns into a liability instead of an asset. Honest answers survive re-reading, which is what gives the ledger its vault of durability and the attacker a opal wall. The panel size is public, so an attacker can compute the expected rejection rate before spending anything.
